record.body:
## Rationale

The repo and the plugin are named orchestra. The skill slugs already name the steps of the loop (`engage`, `discuss`, `plan-phase`, `execute-phase`, `verify-work`, `init`, `analyze-sessions`), so they stay. Renaming those slugs would break every install and every skill document in exchange for a name that only the repo needs.

## Counter-argument

`se-workflow` is the name this loop used before the affidavit rename, and it still shows up in the reviewer agent and in older records. Reusing it would match that history. It also says "workflow" without relying on the plugin description, which orchestra does.

payload.choice: repo and plugin are orchestra; skill slugs stay

record.subject: orchestra-name
